statement: The entire intrinsic cubic pro-3 abelian section group unramified outside3 is Z3^6 direct-sum (Z/3)^3, and every class lifts to a full geometric pro-3 arithmetic section. Its split coordinate-unit map has image Z3^2 generated by Kummer3 in each factor and kernel Z3^4 direct-sum (Z/3)^3.
manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d); section51.15, scans172-178, (373)-(379), in the intrinsic rank10 geometric pro-3 quotient.
notes: Uses the actual rational tangent above t0, with s=-u,t=s^3 and rational constant roots-1. Hain-Matsumoto section8.5 explicitly supplies genuine based unramifiedness. OverK=Q(zeta3), the based action lies in the pro3 IA automorphism kernel of the base free pro3 group; both action and every unramified cocycle factor the same relative quotient P semidirect C2. Kummer S-units and Milne Euler prove P free pro3 of rank2. H2 vanishing solves every finite3-kernel embedding problem, and finite compatible section sets lift all the way to the full rank10 geometric pro3 group. The rank6 and C3^3 torsion are computed using real eigenspaces and rational generalized-Jacobian torsion fromE24. This completes the stated unramified family, not the full classification of ramified intrinsic section classes.
